description.value: James on Hastings is a Chinese-Cantonese restaurant on East Hastings Street in Vancouver offering an extensive menu of dim sum, seafood, hot pots, and Cantonese specialty dishes. The restaurant accepts online orders through its website and a dedicated mobile app. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down dining experience with a broad menu spanning congee, noodles, fried rice, and banquet-style combo dinners.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 28m; rack (8 spaces) at 99m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business is real and operating, with address '2683 E Hastings St, Vancouver' and phone '(604) 255-3188' both matching OSM tags. The website homepage explicitly states online ordering is available and the menu page lists a 'VEGGIE' section, confirming vegetarian options exist. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycle-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. OSM opening hours (Mo-Su 11:00-22:00) conflict with website hours (Mon-Sun 4:00 PM – 1:00 AM); this discrepancy is flagged in concerns.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Mo-Su 11:00-22:00) conflicts with website hours (Mon-Sun 4:00 PM – 1:00 AM); the OSM tag should be corrected.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Chinese-Cantonese restaurant confirmed by live website with matching contact details; a useful dining stop for touring cyclists on East Hastings.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page lists a dedicated 'VEGGIE' section among the menu categories
